How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: It is more formal in Denmark and the teachers are on time, here we sometimes waited 15-20 minuts before they showed up.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Análisis crítico del discurso en español, Historia de España contemporanea, Mujeres y desigualdad social, Patrimonio cultural and Historia de la lingüística.

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: I would recommend Historia de la lingüística, Mujeres y desigualdad social and Análisis crítico del discurso en español.
